title: TikTok Hosts AI-Generated English-Language [person] Speeches with Millions of Views

behaviors.text: AI-generated English-language Adolf [person] speeches have been proliferating on TikTok.
They are reportedly accumulating millions of views despite violating the platform’s hate speech policies.
The clips are described as often pairing the audio with misleading translations and memes that glorify [person] and distort historical facts.
While some content has been removed, many accounts reportedly continue to post similar videos.
